request.state:
Target: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Powering AI, Strengthening the Grid: Innovation in Space Solar Energy and Long-Duration Storage.

Decision cutoff: 2026-04-27T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Powering AI, Strengthening the Grid: Innovation in Space Solar Energy and Long-Duration Storage. Published: 2026-04-27. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/04/powering-ai-strengthening-the-grid-space-solar-energy-and-long-duration-storage.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Advancing AI at the speed and scale we’re working toward requires more energy, but today’s clean energy technologies have real limits: solar depends on sunlight, wind depends on weather, and the grid still needs more storage to make the most of both. Its satellites sit in geosynchronous orbit roughly 22,000 miles above Earth’s equator, where sunlight is constant, collecting energy in space and beaming it to Earth-based solar facilities on the ground as low-intensity, near-infrared light. Under this partnership, Meta has reserved up to 1 GW/100 GWh of ultra-long-duration energy storage capacity, with an initial 25 MW/2.5 GWh pilot demonstration project expected to be completed in 2028. To date, we’ve contracted more than 30 GW of clean and renewable energy, representing billions in capital investments. We are also one of the most significant corporate purchasers of nuclear energy in American history, supporting 7.7 GW of nuclear energy across agreements with Vistra, TerraPower, Oklo and Constellation Energy .

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
